# Class Roster Simulator

> A fully typed Python package and CLI for generating fictional Chinese class rosters, optionally constrained by an inclusive birth-date range.

Use this file as the entry point when an AI agent needs to understand the package.

## Primary documentation

- [README](README.md): installation, CLI usage, Python API, and behavior
- [AI usage guide](AI_USAGE.md): package contract, repository map, development workflow, and validation commands
- [Runnable example](examples/basic_roster.py): minimal application scaffold

## Source and tests

- [Public API](src/class_roster/__init__.py): exported Python names
- [Simulation](src/class_roster/simulation.py): date normalization and roster generation
- [Models](src/class_roster/models.py): `Student` and `ClassRoster`
- [CLI](src/class_roster/cli.py): argument parser and command entry point
- [Tests](tests/): executable behavior and distribution-contract checks

## Key constraints

- Python 3.10 or newer is required.
- `birth_start` and `birth_end` must be supplied together or both omitted.
- Accepted date inputs are `datetime.date`, `YYYY`, `YYYY-MM`, and `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- A year or month expands to the full inclusive interval at the relevant boundary.
- The package contains a `py.typed` marker and is distributed as an inline typed PEP 561 package.
- Generated students are fictional; do not represent them as real people.
